annotations.title: Move a book to a client

description: Move one of the practice's own books to a client's book set (during migration from sole trader to practice). Calls DIY Accounting Submit's own move route, which copies the book and every kept version, verifies each copy, then deletes the source. Refuses when the client already has a book with this id, or the practice has no such book of its own.

bookId.description: The book's id, one of the practice's own
